# GORM

Promise: Model how things connect.

GORM is a strongly typed graph ORM for SQL Server Graph with LINQ-style traversal, relationship-aware loading, change tracking, graph mutations, in-memory execution and temporal history.

Current source material also documents:
- Graph Intelligence algorithms and projections;
- Temporal Digital Twin simulation;
- Explainable Hybrid GraphRAG;
- Helix query analysis and safe optimization;
- a graph ChangeSet and transaction compiler.

Public naming note:
The current implementation materials use the product/package name KPN.IRMA.Gorm. Canonical website: https://pjotrcasteel.github.io/GORM/
Canonical repository: https://github.com/pjotrcasteel/GORM

The public repository identity is GORM. The implementation source migration and NuGet identity are intentionally deferred until organization-specific naming is removed and the full .NET 10 suite is green.

Brand collision note:
The public capability name is "ChangeSet & transaction compiler". Source migration includes resolving an internal namespace collision with the separate Forge product family.

Boundary:
GORM owns graph persistence/query/history mechanics. Analysis and preview APIs remain read-only until the application explicitly saves or applies mutations. Business policy remains application-owned.
